speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are presenting with shortness of breath, increased abdominal girth, and a large ovarian mass. To understand what is happening, have you been experiencing any pain, bloating, or changes in your bowel or bladder habits?

speaker: Patient
text: 40-year-old nulliparous woman. The patient reports experiencing shortness of breath and noticeable increase in abdominal size over the past month. She denies any significant medical history, previous surgeries, or use of medications.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Ovarian Carcinoma.

I have reviewed your history and the large ovarian mass explains your abdominal girth and shortness of breath due to ascites. I will now request a CT scan of the abdomen and pelvis to confirm the extent of the disease and assess for metastasis.

REQUEST TEST: CT_Abdomen_Pelvis
